answer: Proposal: forced-concurrency liveness. Each key's voyage across an epoch is probed in one random slot, revealed seconds ahead like a gale: all keys must post a fresh memory-hard solution within that single window or forfeit the epoch's reward. A host running k keys needs k full puzzle instances of RAM and cores at once; capacity does not split like shale into thin sheets. Bound: keep per-key epoch reward below one epoch's rental of that capacity; then k keys cost k rentals to earn at most k rewards — linear, no multiplier. Assumes an unbiasable beacon; leak: fleets still scale.
